description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Debt Recovery (Special provisions) Act. Regard to the Current rates of bank interest, the Market Rate of Interest shall be Five Point nine eight per Cent (5.98%) Per annum w.e.f. 01st January, 2016
reasoning: This gazette content is a notification issued by the Monetary Board of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka under Section 30 of the Debt Recovery (Special Provisions) Act, No. 02 of 1990. It establishes a new regulatory framework by determining the Market Rate of Interest for debt recovery purposes. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5), which cover regulatory frameworks, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements set by authorities.
